title: Grant Budget Laptop Calculator
description: Grant, unit price, student count -- and the leftover nobody plans for.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club

educational.audience: Club leaders writing a device purchase into a grant

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a grant amount and a chosen device platform, the learner calculates how many laptops the grant can purchase, how much budget remains, and how many students the resulting fleet can serve one-to-one.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Set the grant, platform, and student count and read devices, leftover, and coverage
pedagogical.assessment: Given a grant and a platform, predict the device count and leftover before checking.
